oq77hmot8z0rlcmb.name: Burning Sacrifice
oq77hmot8z0rlcmb.description: When the sun warrior is destroyed, they explode in a blast of flame that deals @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are marked with Walkena's religious symbol on a visible area of their body, which remains for 1 day. This mark allows Walkena to treat the creature as if he knew the creature's identity but not having met them for the purposes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying}, lowering the spell's DC by 2. The sun warrior's gear and treasure are unaffected by the explosion and left in a pile where they die.

un8difxpqnv34qtw.name: Knocking Sweep
un8difxpqnv34qtw.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The sun warrior swings their weapon with a sweeping spin. They attempt separate Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} any number of creatures within their reach. Each attempt counts toward the sun warrior's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all the attacks.

ktu4dcjq7saxgc3c.name: Pinning Thrust
ktu4dcjq7saxgc3c.description: The sun warrior attempts to drive their spear through a foe to pin them in place. The sun warrior makes a spear Strike. On a hit, the target's clothes, armor, or other piece of equipment becomes pinned to the ground. The sun warrior Releases the spear, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until they can remove the spear ([[/act escape dc=27]]). If the Strike was a critical hit, the DC increases by 2.

x19uypog4dal3phf.name: Burning Sacrifice
x19uypog4dal3phf.description: When the sun mage is destroyed, they explode in a blast of flame that deals @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are marked with Walkena's religious symbol on a visible area of their body, which remains for 1 day. This mark allows Walkena to treat the creature as if he knew the creature's identity but not having met them for the purposes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying}, lowering the spell's DC by 2. The sun mage's gear and treasure are unaffected by the explosion and left in a pile where they die.

v1sqye17wnptdsdk.name: Revitalizing Flame
v1sqye17wnptdsdk.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The sun mage produces a specialized flame that burns away maladies and restores a creature. If the sun mage's next action is to Cast a Spell with the fire trait that deals damage and isn't a cantrip, the spell doesn't deal any damage. It instead restores a number of Hit Points equal to four times the spell's rank to all targets or creatures. This restoration affects all creatures regardless of whether they are healed by vitality or void energy.

lhdg7f7vw5jg69eo.name: Death Throes
lhdg7f7vw5jg69eo.description: As the garrison's numbers dwindle, gold defenders melt away into worthless slag. Every time that the garrison is reduced to a threshold, it leaves behind a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot radius} cloud of fumes and a 10-foot radius puddle of molten metal. Creatures that breathe fumes are exposed to gold defender poison. Creatures that move through the puddle take @Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage. The fumes dissipate after 1 round and the puddle completely evaporates after 1 minute.

3rDt1NcX4MLRokS5.name: Golem Antimagic
3rDt1NcX4MLRokS5.description:
Harmed by cold (@Damage[2d8[untyped]] from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area @Damage[2d8[healing]] HP); slowed by acid

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

EjOis3VJMvqzovdO.name: Gold Defender Poison
EjOis3VJMvqzovdO.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:33]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round).

a5k3x5hdv38xi2zz.name: Golden Strike
a5k3x5hdv38xi2zz.description:
1 to 3 actions

Frequency once per round

Effect The garrison makes a melee attack against each enemy in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(2d8+2)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(3d8+12)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(4d8+15)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

SGZ6TPjfU9Nu2TFL.name: Light Reflection
SGZ6TPjfU9Nu2TFL.description:
Requirements The gold defender garrison is not in darkness

Effect The gold defender garrison reshapes its skin into a reflective surface that magnifies ambient light into a precise beam that burns all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:31|name:Light Reflection in Dim Light|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save if the gold defender is in dim light, @Check[reflex|dc:33|name:Light Reflection in Bright Light|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save if it's in bright light). The size of the cone reduces to a @Template[cone|distance:15] when the garrison is reduced to 8 or fewer squares. It can't use Light Reflection again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Light Reflection]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and catches fire, taking @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent fire damage is @Damage[5d6[persistent,fire]].

b2u5y0qk8zdkouor.name: Troop Movement
b2u5y0qk8zdkouor.description: Whenever the garrison Strides, it first Forms Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then moves up to its Speed. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any square enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to the whole troop.

t0kbdtkomlink1o6.name: Death Throes
t0kbdtkomlink1o6.description: When the gold defender is destroyed, it melts into worthless slag. As it melts, it releases a @Template[burst|distance:10] cloud of fumes and a 10-foot radius puddle of molten metal. Creatures that breathe fumes are exposed to gold defender poison. Creatures that move through the puddle take @Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage. The fumes dissipate after 1 round and the puddle cools after 1 minute.

qN5HeFUbiS9Gk3Az.name: Golem Antimagic
qN5HeFUbiS9Gk3Az.description:
Harmed by cold (@Damage[6d10[untyped]], @Damage[2d8[untyped]] from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area @Damage[2d8[healing]] HP); slowed by acid

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

u3e500e7v3a6z9ca.name: Malleable Shape
u3e500e7v3a6z9ca.description: The gold defender's body is made from soft gold, which is particularly pliable. If the gold defender is critically hit with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the attack partially bends and reshapes the gold defender. The gold defender becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until it spends an Interact action to bend itself back into shape.

phr9qusj3at1suqs.name: Vulnerable to Telekinetic Haul
phr9qusj3at1suqs.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul} on the gold defender squeezes its form, compressing it into a smaller and much more awkward shape. The gold defender becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} and can't use Light Reflection. The gold defender must take a 1-minute activity, which has the manipulate trait, to restore its shape, removing the clumsy condition and restoring its Light Reflection.

6H6B7oy5DCoMRLwl.name: Gold Defender Poison
6H6B7oy5DCoMRLwl.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:33]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round).

EGB2VKnTeg8RQSML.name: Inexorable March
EGB2VKnTeg8RQSML.description: The gold defender Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|name:Block Golem Movement] save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the defender's fist Strike.

yCeYAoltBjTFyYoI.name: Light Reflection
yCeYAoltBjTFyYoI.description:
Requirements The gold defender is not in darkness

Effect The gold defender reshapes its skin into a reflective surface that magnifies ambient light into a precise beam that burns all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:31|name:Light Reflection in Dim Light|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save if the gold defender is in dim light, @Check[reflex|dc:33|name:Light Reflection in Bright Light|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save if it's in bright light). It can't use Light Reflection again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Light Reflection]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and catches fire, taking @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent fire damage is @Damage[5d6[persistent,fire]].

0ttw26ibf97lzwbw.name: Cosmic Explosion
0ttw26ibf97lzwbw.description: The soul swarm unleashes a blast of burning sunlight or moonlight, dealing @Damage[(4d8+6)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 20 feet (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the soul swarm is reduced to 8 or fewer squares, this decreases to a @Template[burst|distance:5].

omu5mgrezrjn0d71.name: Soul Grasp
omu5mgrezrjn0d71.description:
1 to 3 actions

Frequency once per round

Effect The soul swarm reaches out and tries to tear at the spiritual energy of enemies within 5 feet (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). The soul swarm can choose to deal slashing damage as it cuts away at a creature, fire damage as it burns other souls away, or void damage as it attempts to unmake a soul. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(2d6+1)[untyped]] damage

2 @Damage[(4d6+11)[untyped]] damage

3 @Damage[(6d6+11)[untyped]] damage

dyjvvrlselw9y3ha.name: Troop Movement
dyjvvrlselw9y3ha.description: Whenever the soul swarm Strides, the soul swarm first Forms Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then moves. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any square of the soul swarm enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to the whole soul swarm.

NIJZV9ABMCIiFD7a.name: Clutching Armor
NIJZV9ABMCIiFD7a.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to move away from the graveknight

Effect The graveknight's armor animates and attempts to Grab the triggering creature. It makes an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} using the graveknight's Athletics modifier - 2. The armor can continue to Grapple the creature normally.

Since the armor is grappling the creature, the graveknight doesn't need a free hand to do so.

YrRTOgGiVvnaIvBj.name: Rejuvenation
YrRTOgGiVvnaIvBj.description:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

prp1eyvaopN5wPkz.name: Channel Magic
prp1eyvaopN5wPkz.description:
The graveknight redirects magical energies through its armor, allowing it to deliver magic through an attack.

The graveknight Casts a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack roll. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into an attack instead. The graveknight then makes a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack. The spell is coupled with the attack, using the attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell.

This counts as two attacks for the graveknight's multiple attack penalty but doesn't apply the penalty until after it's completed Channeling Magic.

The graveknight can't use Channel Magic again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Channel Magic]]{1d4 rounds}.

UMyRwmu03NP1OaDn.name: Devastating Blast
UMyRwmu03NP1OaDn.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[8d12[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

MaRy1P1W5DdCPIDq.name: Graveknight's Curse
MaRy1P1W5DdCPIDq.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:36] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, speed penalty of -10 feet, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

ivsNAUrOafOxexf5.name: Weapon Master
ivsNAUrOafOxexf5.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

Dimari-Diji.name: Dimari-Diji
Dimari-Diji.languages: speak with animals, speak with plants, telepathy 300 feet

5lje2ycszeroe78j.name: Aura of Growth
5lje2ycszeroe78j.description:
120 feet. Plants near Dimari-Diji grow larger and more vibrant. Plants in the emanation gain the success effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZhJ8d9Uk4lwIx86b]{Plant Growth} ritual. Any plant spells cast in the area are empowered and use the effects of the spell 1 rank higher than it was cast, to a maximum of 9th rank (Dimari-Diji's spells are unaffected). Finally, other plant creatures gain fast healing 20 while in the area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.PR0YzItS9R60X3Zc]{Effect: Aura of Growth}

xddswapz1ann8la4.name: Axe Vulnerability
xddswapz1ann8la4.description: An arboreal nature-speaker takes 20 additional damage from axes.

fyc0be1oh68wntby.name: Enriching Aura
fyc0be1oh68wntby.description: 60 feet. Dimari-Diji's natural power enhances primal spellcasting around him. All creatures within the emanation can alter a primal spell as if they had just used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BWomK7EVY0WXxWgh]{Reach Spell} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FoWO4RnHRwfEIC7Q]{Widen Spell} when they Cast the Spell.

y7jdf4xuof4dpf8w.name: Fungus Sight
y7jdf4xuof4dpf8w.description: Dimari-Diji produces small clumps of fungus that he can use to see beyond his normal sight. He can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to project his senses into an intact fungus clump on the Material Plane or to end this projection. Dimari-Diji loses all sensory information from his own body while projecting his senses into fungus.

mvjvrpdegbcgd6sd.name: Forest Growth
mvjvrpdegbcgd6sd.description: Once per month, Dimari-Diji can spend 1 hour to sprout a new forest. He causes the forest to sprout in a @Template[burst|distance:50] within 300 feet. The forest instantly springs to life, and is composed of fungi, plants, and trees most appropriate to the area he selected. The forest grows to the height, density, and liveliness of a forest that has grown for 10 years. The forest doesn't feature any animals or other creatures, but animals within 1 mile are aware of the new forest and might make the forest their new habitat as appropriate.

pgfhg72vpcjz5m51.name: Memories of Ages
pgfhg72vpcjz5m51.description: Dimari-Diji's mental blasts cloud the minds of his foes, making it difficult for them to focus on combat. A creature that takes damage from Dimari-Diji's mental blast is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. If the attack was a critical hit, the creature is dazzled for 1 minute instead.

egtbx7p7vflyi5o6.name: Memory Maelstrom
egtbx7p7vflyi5o6.description:
Dimari - Diji tries to overwhelm foes with a surge of information he has absorbed over his long life. This surge deals @Damage[12d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to each enemy within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 feet}, who must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature maintains its composure, takes no damage, and is temporarily immune to Memory Maelstrom for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for [[/gmr 2d4 #Confusion Duration]]{2d4 rounds}, and is stunned 3.

eqzvkhmwgoufiid6.name: Nature's Concentration
eqzvkhmwgoufiid6.description:
Trigger Dimari-Diji's turn begins

Effect Dimari-Diji calls upon the natural world around him to support his magic. He Sustains a Spell.

6x0bkjezr6333mqm.name: Blinding Aura
6x0bkjezr6333mqm.description: 60 feet. The sunburst corpse sheds bright light. Any creature that starts its turn in the emanation must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save. If it fails, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute, and if it critically fails, it's blinded permanently. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.

zu8bqkgi8bpopt54.name: Darkness Vulnerability
zu8bqkgi8bpopt54.description: A sunburst corpse is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} while in areas of magical darkness. If the level of the magical darkness effect is at least half of the sunburst corpse's level (a 7th-rank effect against most sunburst corpses), the sunburst corpse is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} while in the area.

s7iuu46czym34fcj.name: Light Camouflage
s7iuu46czym34fcj.description: The sunburst corpse is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in areas of natural bright light, such as due to sunlight or torches, even to creatures that can see clearly in bright light. Magical bright light and light from the sunburst corpse's blinding aura don't conceal the sunburst corpse.

GwIFweEMjNfnhHBa.name: Constrict
GwIFweEMjNfnhHBa.description:
@Damage[(2d6+6)[bludgeoning],2d8[fire]]{2d6+6 bludgeoning plus 2d8 fire} and Residual Light, @Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

pwl8fa1ev5dj8d7q.name: Nova Burst
pwl8fa1ev5dj8d7q.description: The sunburst corpse intensifies its light and unleashes a burning blast of energy. It deals @Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect] save). A creature that fails its save becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn. The sunburst corpse can't use Nova Burst again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Nova Burst]]{1d4 rounds}, and its blinding aura becomes inactive during this time.

vrzmuimx9amhj6g0.name: Residual Light
vrzmuimx9amhj6g0.description: When a sunburst corpse Strikes or Grapples a creature, some of the corpse's light clings to the creature for a moment. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn. On a critical failure, the creature is dazzled for 1 minute. A dazzled creature can use an Interact action to wick off the light and remove the dazzled condition.

Nkiruka.name: Nkiruka
Nkiruka.gm:
Influence 1 The heroes automatically gain 1 Influence Point and reach this threshold after their first meeting with Nkiruka at the temple.

Influence 2 Nkiruka trusts the heroes enough to end their escort detail. The heroes can move through Mzali without escorts, though they must still follow other laws. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 3 Nkiruka marks the delegation as an important group in Mzali. They can now attempt to use the Contact a Mzali Figure activity to meet with the Council of Mwanyisa. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 4 Nkiruka marks the delegation as a priority group in Mzali. Nkiruka requires that other important figures prioritize more time meeting with the delegation. The heroes can now engage in 2 rounds of social encounters per week. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 5 Nkiruka grants the delegation access to the tombs of the Necropolis in the western part of the city. This serves as an opportunity for Practical Research as the heroes can study the history and relics of the countless tombs within the Necropolis. At your discretion, they might encounter dangers in the form of undead, traps, and other common tomb hazards. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 6 Nkiruka appreciates how well the delegation has interacted with the people of Mzali. She offers the opportunity for further integration in the form of language lessons. The heroes can take these lessons to learn to read and speak Mzunu, the official language of the city. This requires one month of downtime of intense lessons. A hero can instead spend the month to learn to sign Mzunu, or two months of downtime to learn both the spoken and signed language. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 7 Nkiruka provides servants and assistants to the delegation to aid the heroes during their time in Mzali. This help grants a +2 circumstance bonus to all skill checks the heroes make while within Mzali, including checks to Influence or Discover. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 8 Nkiruka feels that the heroes have done more than enough to earn an audience with Walkena himself. The heroes gain 80 XP.

Resistances Nkiruka is a professional and above threats of all kinds. Attempts to use Intimidation or other aggressive negotiation tactics draw her ire, which trickles down as consequences with others. This increases the DC of checks with other figures by 2 for 1 week.

Weaknesses Nkiruka is above allowing her emotions get in the way of her work and lacks any true weakness that can be taken advantage of during negotiations.
Nkiruka.perception: +29 to notice lies and sense motive

LSb7bSeQRrEh2eyF.name: +4 to Notice Lies or Sense Motive
LSb7bSeQRrEh2eyF.description: +29 to notice lies and Sense Motive

zm7h079en49435hi.name: Ear for Lies
zm7h079en49435hi.description: Nkiruka's training allows her to recognize microexpressions, voice tone, and other tells. When a creature fails to Lie to Nkiruka, not only does she know they were lying, she also receives a clue about what that creature believes to be the truth.

pst9oigxxhqbv2nz.name: Group Impression
pst9oigxxhqbv2nz.description: When Nkiruka Makes an Impression, she can compare her Diplomacy check result to the Will DCs of up to four targets instead of one.

vfxgkirg3wl676h4.name: Eye for an Opening
vfxgkirg3wl676h4.description: Nkiruka's Strikes against creatures she observes that don't have cover and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} deal an additional 2d10 precision damage.

3b5ryi2mtgy8eg1h.name: Size Up
3b5ryi2mtgy8eg1h.description: Nkiruka attempts a @Check[perception] check against the Deception DC or Will DC, whichever is higher, of a creature she can see. On a success, she gleans a notable detail about the creature as if she had successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recalled Knowledge} about it. Once Nkiruka has Sized Up a creature, she can't do so again for 1 day.

e12xgoitz86e6tmn.name: Impaling Strike
e12xgoitz86e6tmn.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The Jackal Guard lunges forward with their spear and delivers a piercing blow. The Jackal Guard Steps and then makes a melee spear Strike. On a hit, the target also takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]].

juntvowtsn9qcqkr.name: Knocking Sweep
juntvowtsn9qcqkr.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The Jackal Guard swings their weapon with a sweeping spin. They attempt separate Athletics checks to Trip any number of creatures within their reach. Each attempt counts toward the Jackal Guard's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all the attacks.

6pA9JNKUwzhojpz2.name: Spear Vault
6pA9JNKUwzhojpz2.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The Jackal Guard uses their spear to jump over or around a creature and create an opening. The Jackal Guard Strides up to half their Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. During this movement, they can move through the space of one creature, and when the Jackal Guard moves through a creature's space in this way, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the Jackal Guard's turn. If the Jackal Guard ends their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

5jcyj8fswkazu3tr.name: Inspired Feast
5jcyj8fswkazu3tr.description: If a biloko feasts on a human corpse for 1 minute or more, they gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 hour.

orec2boz49au2bis.name: Terrifying Roar
orec2boz49au2bis.description: The biloko reaver unleashes a frightful roar. Any non-biloko within 30 feet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). Those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

L4D1x2Fyk8QUPQLj.name: Inspired Feast
L4D1x2Fyk8QUPQLj.description: If a biloko feasts on a human corpse for 1 minute or more, they gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 hour.

u89ymekcydoi9ct1.name: Size Alteration
u89ymekcydoi9ct1.description: Gambulami is affected by a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell. This lasts for 1 minute, and Gambulami can Dismiss the Spell.

9sksf4mrxjucvyx4.name: Thrashing Chomp
9sksf4mrxjucvyx4.description:
Requirements Gambulami is larger than Small in size and has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with his jaws

Effect Gambulami whips the creature around, smashing it against other nearby creatures. He makes an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the grabbed creature's Fortitude DC. Regardless of the result, the creature is released from Gambulami's jaws afterward, escaping into the space in which it was grabbed.

Critical Success Gambulami uses a mighty spin to smash the held creature against every creature within his reach. Every creature, including the grabbed creature, takes @Damage[(1d10+7)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Success As critical success, but creatures take @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The creature breaks free.

Critical Failure The creature breaks free and Gambulami's spin causes him to fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

i25c0ozx20b2bbav.name: Reactive
i25c0ozx20b2bbav.description: A ba'aupa mdoudu gains an additional reaction at the start of its turn but can use this reaction only to Slime Squirt.

yeba3x3nds2gp23n.name: Skeleton Sense 60 feet
yeba3x3nds2gp23n.description: Aba'aupa mdoudu can sense the presence of bones and skeletons within 60 feet; this is a precise sense when detecting dead bones but an imprecise one when detecting living bones.

xp6suouexybxu8my.name: Slime Squirt
xp6suouexybxu8my.description:
Trigger A creature inflicts slashing or piercing damage on the ba'aupa mdoudu with a melee Strike

Effect The attacking creature takes @Damage[2d10[acid]] damage.

8zf1s7593q6pl97e.name: Caustic Acid
8zf1s7593q6pl97e.description: Whenever a creature takes acid damage from any of a ba'aupa mdoudu's abilities or Strikes, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). On each subsequent failure, the drained condition value increases by 1 (or by 2 on a critical failure), to a maximum of drained 4.

z82nv8bd8xox1ply.name: Caustic Rain
z82nv8bd8xox1ply.description: The ba'aupa mdoudu spews copious amounts of acid into the air, creating a cascading rain to fall in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around itself. All creatures in the area take @Damage[14d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save) plus Caustic Acid. The ba'aupa mdoudu can't use Caustic Rain again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Caustic Rain]]{1d4 rounds}.

zjynccqgrawr2vhs.name: Stone Tunneler
zjynccqgrawr2vhs.description: A ba'aupa mdoudu can leave a tunnel when it burrows through earth or stone, and it usually does.

Dajermube.name: Dajermube
Dajermube.description:
This undead guardian stands amid a whirling swarm of shackled spirits that rage against their fate. Bound by a profane necromantic ritual, a nemhaith and its servitors maintain watch over an object or place so important they embraced undeath to guard it. This ritual binds connected beings-friends, family, fellow worshippers, or even sacrificed innocents-to form a single nemhaith.

Most nemhaiths were, in life, priests or protectors who sought immortality to protect the temple they served or guard an important landmark. Others follow an endless and even impossible quest beyond the bounds of life and death. A nemhaith is not always evil at first, but the inherent evil and violence of a nemhaith's existence inevitably darkens even the brightest light.

i2dPxUSrwIfJyjPU.name: Rejuvenation
i2dPxUSrwIfJyjPU.description: Destroying the ritual object or place used in the nemhaith's creation destroys the nemhaith, freeing its bound spirits to move on to the afterlife.

1RMu0owaI3jzGIJA.name: Site Bound
1RMu0owaI3jzGIJA.description: The nemhaith is bound to a place or large stationary object and can't venture more than 500 feet from this focus.

0hSL8u2ImY5BTyJo.name: Drain Life
0hSL8u2ImY5BTyJo.description:
When the nemhaith damages a living creature with its spirit tendril Strike, the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:36|options:inflicts:drained] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Further damage dealt by the nemhaith increases the condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

BVGtxqRvaiXmxNDG.name: Rage of Spirits
BVGtxqRvaiXmxNDG.description: The nemhaith's bound spirits rage and smash everything in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. Creatures in this area take @Damage[4d6[sonic],4d6[void]|options:area-damage]{4d6 sonic damage and 4d6 void damage} (@Check[fortitude|dc:36|basic|options:area-effect] save).

iXMM9LrLHQONVyO1.name: Throw Spirits
iXMM9LrLHQONVyO1.description: The nemhaith directs its bound spirits as a group to move up to 1 mile away (they have a fly Speed of 60 feet). The nemhaith can see and hear through the thrown spirits, but it loses its aura and can't use its spirit dart ranged Strike or Rage of Spirits. The nemhaith regains these abilities when the spirits return to the nemhaith's space.

orBkSImTP2bkbSCY.name: Burning Sacrifice
orBkSImTP2bkbSCY.description: When the sun hunter is destroyed, they explode in a blast of flame that deals @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are marked with Walkena's religious symbol on a visible area of their body, which remains for 1 day. This mark allows Walkena to treat the creature as if he knew the creature's identity but not having met them for the purposes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying}, lowering the spell's DC by 2. The sun hunter's gear and treasure are unaffected by the explosion and left in a pile where they die.

tyt6p82kfjac93i8.name: Nimble Dodge
tyt6p82kfjac93i8.description:
Trigger The sun hunter is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see

Effect The sun hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Xoa0KLxTvGaKuPij.name: Sneak Attack
Xoa0KLxTvGaKuPij.description: The sun hunter's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

a96pdh6130w53g5a.name: Study Foe
a96pdh6130w53g5a.description:
The sun hunter reads a creature they can see within 30 feet to notice openings. The sun hunter attempts a Perception check against that creature's Deception DC or Will DC, whichever is higher. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The sun hunter reads the target like a book. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the sun hunter's attacks until the end of the sun hunter's next turn.

Success The sun hunter notices a brief opening. The target is off-guard against the sun hunter's attacks until the end of the sun hunter's turn.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure The sun hunter's intense focus opens them up to other attacks. The target is unaffected, and the sun hunter is off-guard until the start of their next turn.

cayZLGHrwDiRg60D.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 14)
cayZLGHrwDiRg60D.description:
Like normal objects, the Living Sun-Spire has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness.

Once the statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 32.

5fuz5dej9owm5ap2.name: Steal the Sun
5fuz5dej9owm5ap2.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the sun-spire begins to Cast a Spell that has the fire or light trait

Effect The sun-spire attempts to redirect the energy from the triggering effect into its sunlight stores. The sun-spire attempts to counteract the triggering spell with a [[/r {1d20+22} #counteract]]{+22} counteract bonus. If it successfully counteracts the spell, the sun-spire's sunlight stores are empowered. While empowered, the sun-spire deals an additional @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage with all of its attacks and abilities. The sun-spire remains empowered until the end of its next turn.

aafpuxt66c9n4wag.name: Beam of the Seven Suns
aafpuxt66c9n4wag.description: The sun-spire collects solar energy and uses the energy to create a deadly beam of fire. It fires the beam in a @Template[line|distance:120], dealing @Damage[11d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the line (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save). The concentrated beam ignites everything in its path, including the air, creating a wall of burning flame along the line that continues to burn until the end of the sun-spire's next turn. This wall has the effects of a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} spell, dealing @Damage[5d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to any creature that crosses the wall or occupies the wall's area at the start of its turn. The sun-spire can't use the Beam of the Seven Suns again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, although rounds it's not in sunlight don't count toward this number.

oxt3avp66riyk2nh.name: Frenetic Assault
oxt3avp66riyk2nh.description:
1 to 3 actions

Frequency once per round

Effect The members of the brigade wildly swing their weapons-primarily spears-in a frenzied attack at each enemy adjacent to the troop (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d12+1)[piercing]] damage

2 @Damage[(2d12+11)[piercing]] damage

3 @Damage[(3d12+11)[piercing]] damage

27wk99n7dr6shzeq.name: Troop Movement
27wk99n7dr6shzeq.description: Whenever the troop Strides, they first Form Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then move up to their Speed. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any square of the troop enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to the whole troop.

esi9bcvmzm1ej8ef.name: Troop Spellcasting
esi9bcvmzm1ej8ef.description: When the sun warrior brigade Casts a Spell, its constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

08c6nxgvp7vwy8xp.name: Walkena's Radiance
08c6nxgvp7vwy8xp.description: The brigade calls upon Walkena to burn and blind their foes. The sun warriors present their religious symbols and create a white-hot flash of light in a @Template[cone|distance:45]. Creatures in the cone take @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save). Creatures that fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. Creatures that critically fail become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round instead. When the troop is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a @Template[cone|distance:20].

k6huke9t2ijs9bpi.name: Smoke Vision
k6huke9t2ijs9bpi.description: Smoke doesn't impair a grave karina's vision; they ignore the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke, including the ash they create with their Breath Weapon.

hi9wc4nby4koo9ce.name: Sound Imitation
hi9wc4nby4koo9ce.description: A grave karina who succeeds at a Deception check to Lie can mimic any voice they have heard. They have a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.

s2mzlew9qheay8r5.name: Breath Weapon
s2mzlew9qheay8r5.description: The grave karina breathes a cloud of burning ash in @Template[cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[9d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save). The area becomes filled with ash for 1 round. All creatures within the cloud of ash become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it. The grave karina can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

fla0tchrqivbtx1v.name: Grave Blight
fla0tchrqivbtx1v.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage, every hour the victim must succeed at another Fortitude save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 day)

m16ky4ctpaioader.name: Mocking Cry
m16ky4ctpaioader.description: The grave karina mimics a voice and mocks a creature within 30 feet. They attempt a Deception check to Demoralize the creature. Regardless of whether the check succeeds, the target is temporarily immune to the grave karina's mocking cry for 1 hour.

d52gdryulshd2ukd.name: Shadow Command
d52gdryulshd2ukd.description:
Frequency once per day Requirements The grave karina is adjacent to a creature that's casting a shadow

Effect The grave karina drives a talon into a creature's shadow and attempts to manipulate it like a puppet with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate}(@Check[will|dc:27|traits:mental,incapacitation] save), except the duration is only 1 minute.

s0v5optc2gsszyyc.name: Avatar's Resistance
s0v5optc2gsszyyc.description:
Trigger The avatar fails or critically fails a saving throw Frequency once per minute

Effect Walkena's will attempts to undo his avatar's fate. The avatar rerolls the saving throw and takes the better result.

ajikopzmesnzqx88.name: Smoke Vision
ajikopzmesnzqx88.description: The avatar ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

33ljgbx6bddbttay.name: Sun's Touch
33ljgbx6bddbttay.description: 10 feet. The avatar of Walkena radiates with an intense light. Creatures that enter or begin their turn in the emanation are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} and take @Damage[3d8[fire]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:35|basic] save). Creatures remain dazzled until they leave the emanation.

yy8vbnwfxfj86fv8.name: Pull Down the Sun
yy8vbnwfxfj86fv8.description: The avatar of Walkena plucks a small drop of sunlight from the sky and rains down sunfire on the battlefield. The avatar selects a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 90 feet. Sunfire rains down in the area, dealing @Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect] save) to all creatures that enter or begin their turn in the area. The power of the sun restores the avatar; it instead recovers an equal number of Hit Points while in the area. The sunfire continues to rain until the end of the avatar's next turn. The avatar can't use Pull Down the Sun again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Pull Down the Sun]]{1d4 rounds}.

s4kk8xce6s8xp1y3.name: Radiate Glory
s4kk8xce6s8xp1y3.description:
The avatar intensifies its light. All creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:38] save. The avatar can't use Radiate Glory again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiate Glory]]{1d4 rounds}. During this time, the avatar's Sun Touch no longer dazzles creatures.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute.

7bsb9tpgqx3nzgqd.name: Despairing Presence
7bsb9tpgqx3nzgqd.description:
60 feet. A creature that enters the emanation or starts its turn within it tumbles down a deep well of dread and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it's no longer frightened.

tzhwamd48xkcm2zr.name: Emotion Sense 60 feet
tzhwamd48xkcm2zr.description: A kilia mwibo can sense nearby negative emotions. This is a precise sense against creatures who are under powerful emotion effects like rage, those who are frightened, or, at the GM's discretion, those who are in the grips of hatred, sadness, or other overwhelming negative emotions. Against all other creatures that possess emotions, this is an imprecise sense. A creature that has no emotions is effectively @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to a kilia mwibo. A creature that knows about emotion sense can take precautions to Hide and Sneak from a kilia mwibo, in this case by suppressing feelings of negativity.

mq9s4yu5bx9phcyh.name: Consume Emotion
mq9s4yu5bx9phcyh.description: The kilia mwibo feeds on the negative emotions of a creature within 60 feet; this must be a creature that it can precisely sense with its emotion sense. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:36] save or increase its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition value by 1 (by 2 on a critical failure), to a maximum of drained 4.

3US5FatueRfGAZ7c.name: Graveknight's Shield
3US5FatueRfGAZ7c.description:
The graveknight's curse extends to their shield, or the graveknight's armor uses a portion of itself to produce a shield.

The graveknight has a shield that uses the statistics of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f9ygr5Cjrmop8LWV]{Sturdy Shield (Minor)}.

The shield is quasi-independent of the graveknight and automatically protects the graveknight from harm. When the shield is raised, it automatically uses Shield Block to reduce the damage of the first attack against the graveknight each round without the graveknight needing to spend their reaction to do so.

The shield automatically rejuvenates with the rest of the graveknight and must be destroyed in the same manner as the graveknight's armor.

M90XXPKRSxcfX8Bp.name: Rejuvenation
M90XXPKRSxcfX8Bp.description:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

VlBz45NrxIlkRrjr.name: Devastating Blast
VlBz45NrxIlkRrjr.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[4d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

CLM2GK3AQanqMse1.name: Graveknight's Curse
CLM2GK3AQanqMse1.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:24] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, speed penalty of -10 feet, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

ivsNAUrOafOxexf5.name: Weapon Master
ivsNAUrOafOxexf5.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

9t8z4ipcfdm9n9g0.name: Aquatic Camouflage
9t8z4ipcfdm9n9g0.description: When fully submerged in water, the drenchdead can Hide from other creatures even if it doesn't have cover against them and isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from them.

5ctvamroe8ajizmd.name: Drag Down
5ctvamroe8ajizmd.description:
Requirements The drenchdead is swimming in water at least 10 feet deep

Effect The drenchdead attempts an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water). On a success against a creature on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, the drenchdead pulls the creature into the water into a space adjacent to itself. If the creature is already in the water, on a success, in addition the normal effects of Grapple, the drenchdead drags the creature 10 feet deeper, moving 10 feet with the creature. Moving a creature into water or deeper into water using Drag Down is forced movement for the target creature, but not for the drenchdead.

iutmvzp6aq8ubdqv.name: Drowning Touch
iutmvzp6aq8ubdqv.description:
The drenchdead touches a creature and causes water from its own body to flow into the creature's lungs. If the creature can't breathe water, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Drowning Touch for 24 hours.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}.

Critical Failure The creature chokes on the water and runs out of air. It falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and starts drowning. If the creature is above water, it recovers from drowning as soon as it succeeds at a saving throw against suffocation.

wfrdw45o1bdjmfyz.name: Surface Skimmer
wfrdw45o1bdjmfyz.description: A drenchdead submerged in water has cover from attacks made by creatures out of the water.

Worknesh.name: Worknesh
Worknesh.gm:
Discovery @Check[mzali-lore|dc:32], @Check[perception|dc:37], @Check[society|dc:35]

Influence Skills @Check[intimidation|dc:35|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat] (to discuss offensive combat techniques), @Check[acrobatics|dc:35|name:Discuss Defensive Combat Techniques] (to discuss defensive combat techniques), @Check[athletics|dc:35|name:Discuss Training Techniques] (to discuss training techniques), @Check[intimidation|dc:35|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat], @Check[mzali-lore|dc:35|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat], @Check[deception|dc:37|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat], @Check[diplomacy|dc:39|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat], @Check[performance|dc:39|name:Discuss Defensive Performative Aspects of Combat] (to discuss the performative aspects of combat), @Check[society|dc:39]

Influence 2 Worknesh invites the delegation to a combat performance later in the week. The performance features members of the Jackal Guard engaging in sparring matches and retellings of the history of Mzali, with exciting combat peppered in. The heroes are under no obligation to go, but if they do, they are Worknesh's esteemed guests. During the performance, she takes the time to introduce the heroes to other key leaders in the city: Themba, Wekesa, and Zubari. This meeting gives the heroes inroads to contact these other leaders (even though Themba is decidedly cool to Worknesh). If the heroes' next attempt to Contact a Mzali Figure is to reach out to Themba, Wekesa, or Zubari, the attempt has a result no worse than a success.

Influence 4 Worknesh wants to know the delegation's combat capabilities and invites the heroes to an exhibition fight. See Worknesh's Challenge for details on how this plays out.

Influence 6 Worknesh acknowledges that the delegation is unlikely to pose a threat to the city and shares her approval with Nkiruka. This earns the heroes 1 Influence Point with Nkiruka. The heroes gain 30 XP.

Influence 8 Worknesh finds a kind of kinship with the delegation, recognizing its ambition. She presents the heroes with a cache of armaments as a gift and sign of respect-or of pity if she genuinely thinks they're poor combatants. While the armaments are very elegant, Worknesh is against mistreatment of weaponry by making them more decorative than functional-each piece can be used in a fight. The armaments include a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.RUEAV5LMUGFHcXcW]{Warleader's Bulwark}, an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KrtZmC3qfZIGXu76]{Iron Equalizer}, and a +1 striking axiomatic @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rXt4629QSg7KDTgJ]{Warhammer} with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ah9jxSBerznPowW7]{Greater Binding Coil} affixed to it.

piozygvswzbwhv9x.name: Master's Cry
piozygvswzbwhv9x.description:
Trigger Worknesh rolls initiative

Requirements Worknesh can perceive at least one foe within 60 feet

Effect Worknesh yells a mighty rallying cry. Worknesh attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] a single foe within 60 feet. If successful, any of her allies within 30 feet can Stride up to double their speed as their first action on their first turn of the combat.

0q48g0slb1nvwana.name: Warmaster's Instinct
0q48g0slb1nvwana.description: Worknesh can recognize the skills of any combatants she faces. She can use Warfare Lore to Recall Knowledge about any creature, but only while in combat or observing the creature fight.

5fcubhgvrgux06na.name: Battle Cry
5fcubhgvrgux06na.description:
Worknesh unleashes a war cry, granting herself and all allies within 60 feet a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the start of her next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TjRZbd52qWPjTbNT]{Effect: Battle Cry}

3dnz7i71dj85bgb7.name: Walkena's Fury
3dnz7i71dj85bgb7.description:
Frequency once per round Requirements Worknesh is within reach of an enemy designated by Walkena's Judgment

Effect Worknesh makes two melee Strikes against the enemy of Walkena. If both attacks hit, she combines their damage for the purpose of the creature's resistances and weaknesses.

lubmx5ry4yjy1q8b.name: Walkena's Judgment
lubmx5ry4yjy1q8b.description: Worknesh designates a single creature as an enemy of Walkena. She must be able to see or hear the creature, or she must be tracking the creature. Worknesh gains a +4 status bonus to damage against the designated creature, and she gains fast healing 5 while within 30 feet of the creature. In addition, she doesn't take the -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls when attempting to deal nonlethal damage with an attack without the nonlethal trait and vice versa. Worknesh can have only one creature designated as an enemy of Walkena at a time. If she uses Walkena's Judgment against a creature when she already has a creature designated, the prior creature loses the designation and the new target gains the designation. This designation lasts for 24 hours.
